name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
headline: Technical Onboarding & Customer Enablement Specialist

Builds and documents the automation and AI-driven workflows behind client systems at Solenzo, using Claude Code, Python, and JavaScript in production automation platforms, and runs client workshops and consultative account reviews as a standing practice. Comfortable learning a new technical stack quickly and translating it for both engineering and business stakeholders.

Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface client goals, objectives, and market challenges.
Architect and implement CRM systems in GoHighLevel (primary) and HubSpot — contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and lead-routing logic, with strict data-hygiene protocols.
